name.es: La Corteza de la Estrella de Neutrones

facts.claim: Isolated magnetar radiates ~10^25 W as soft X-rays and low-energy gamma rays from residual thermal cooling and magnetic field decay.
facts.justification: Stefan-Boltzmann law for R≈11 km and T≈10^6 K matches observed anomalous X-ray pulsar luminosities without requiring exotic heating.

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: No optical photosynthesis; soft X-ray/gamma sky sets energy budget.

facts.claim: Crust rotates with a 2.3-second period, driving stochastic giant flares (10^44–10^46 erg) via crustal yield fractures and magnetic reconnection.
facts.justification: Magnetar spin periods typically span 2–12 seconds; flares are stochastic reconnection events, not spin-locked periodic phenomena.

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Rotation provides a predictable macroscopic clock for timekeeping
Giant flares act as rare, stochastic global sterilization hazards
Forces stasis or deep-burrow survival tactics during outbursts.

facts.claim: Solid crust has an 11.2 km radius and 1.7×10^11 g surface gravity, balancing neutron degeneracy pressure against gravitational collapse.
facts.justification: Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff limit and chiral EFT constraints fix neutron star mass-radius relations and surface acceleration.

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Crushes macroscopic bodies to sub-micron scale
Habitable size class restricted to lattice defect complexes, not kg-scale morphology.

facts.claim: No gaseous atmosphere exists; the habitable medium is a degenerate electron sea permeating a crystalline ion lattice, capped by a highly variable magnetospheric particle veneer.
facts.justification: Hydrostatic equilibrium in degenerate matter yields a scale height <0.1 m; only a collisionless magnetospheric veneer extends outward, not a fixed hydrostatic cap.

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Requires direct lattice contact for respiration.

facts.claim: Lattice vibrations (phonons) propagate at ~1.2×10^6 m/s through the degenerate crust, serving as the primary medium for mechanical communication and seismic sensing.
facts.justification: Bulk modulus K≈10^33 dyne/cm² and density ρ≈10^14 g/cm³ yield sound speeds approaching 0.004c in the nuclear lattice.

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Enables µm–mm effective communication range at µs cadence
Reveals terrain structure via echo mapping

facts.claim: A 3.5×10^14 G dipolar magnetic field dominates QED, transport, and orientation channels, enforcing Zeeman splitting and aligning nuclear spins along flux tubes; elasticity and gravity set substrate geometry.
facts.justification: Magnetar-class surface fields exceed the QED critical field (B_c≈4.4×10^13 G), making magnetic energy density > thermal energy density for charged particles.

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Enforces pancake morphology to minimize Lorentz stress

facts.claim: The inner crust hosts nuclear pasta phases (lasagna, gnocchi, spaghetti) where competing strong-force clustering and Coulomb repulsion minimize free energy at density gradients.
facts.justification: Chamel & Haensel (2008) phase diagrams show entropy minimization produces rod, bubble, and slab structures at 0.5–0.8 nuclear saturation density.

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Creates fluid-like phase boundaries for gliding (highly speculative ecology)
Releases latent heat during phase transitions.

facts.claim: Neutron drip occurs at a density threshold of ~4×10^11 g/cm³, releasing free neutrons that flow downward via chemical potential gradients into the superfluid core.
facts.justification: Nuclear shell model and drip-line calculations place neutron unbinding at this density, driving core-crust neutron flux.

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Creates vertical chemical gradients for foraging
Triggers lattice shear if proton contamination occurs.

facts.claim: Crustal glitches release up to 10^38 erg when pinned superfluid vortices unpin and transfer angular momentum, fracturing the lattice and ejecting neutron-rich matter.
facts.justification: Anderson & Itoh (1975) and Chamel (2013) model glitches as sudden vortex unpinning events transferring rotational energy to the crust.

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Generates seismic events correlated with pinning/unpinning statistics (model-dependent)

facts.claim: Relativistic degenerate electrons provide extreme screening and conduction, enabling rapid quantum tunneling; Fermi velocity approaches c in the inner crust.
facts.justification: Electron Fermi energy exceeds rest mass in the inner crust, creating a relativistic Fermi gas that screens Coulomb repulsion and facilitates tunneling.

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

facts.claim: Metabolic energy derives from weak-interaction beta decay cycles and latent heat released during solid-solid pasta phase transitions; ~8 MeV/nucleon represents the nuclear binding energy scale, not direct per-reaction yield.
facts.justification: Nuclear binding energy gradients and magnetic decay supply work far exceeding kT at crust temperatures, driving non-Arrhenius chemistry.

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Ties energy budget to magnetic field strength
Generates waste heat requiring lattice dissipation.

facts.claim: Macroscopic life is constrained to sub-micron quasi-crystalline defect complexes; metabolic cycles run at microsecond timescales due to weak interaction and phonon transport limits.
facts.justification: Nuclear timescales Γ≈10^6 s⁻¹ and 10^11 g gravity prevent macroscopic structures; life operates as lattice defect ensembles limited by phonon propagation and weak decay rates (highly speculative).

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Limits sensory range to µm–mm lattice cells.

facts.claim: Organisms metabolize neutron-rich nuclear clusters and magnetic reconnection sparks, while proton-rich contaminants trigger inverse beta decay and risk crust fracture / micro-glitch nucleation.
facts.justification: Proton capture catalyzes p+e⁻→n+ν_e, disrupting neutron drip equilibrium and exceeding crustal break stress.

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Drives evolutionary pressure toward neutron stability.

facts.claim: Hereditary information is stored in topological flux-tube entanglements and lattice defect patterns, replicated via electron-mediated quantum tunneling between nuclear clusters; relies on metastable isomers with finite lifetimes.
facts.justification: QED-stabilized nuclear isomers and flux-tube knots provide stable information carriers in degenerate matter (highly speculative; requires stated metastable lifetimes).

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Ties inheritance to magnetic field topology
Allows rapid adaptation via defect reconfiguration.

facts.claim: Reproduction occurs through lattice conjugation, where adjacent defect complexes exchange nuclear fragments and share adaptive isotopic traits across the degenerate medium via resonant tunneling at shared interfaces.
facts.justification: Degenerate electron gas enables heavy-nucleus tunneling, allowing direct nuclear exchange without gaseous diffusion (highly speculative; requires intimate lattice contact + resonant defect channel).

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

facts.claim: Organism phenomenological rate ~10^6× faster than human baseline; stellar spin 2.3 s and flare/glitch hazards set macro rhythm, not cell cycle.
facts.justification: Explicit time-layer rule reconciles microsecond biological cycles with second-scale stellar dynamics.

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Decouples local metabolism from global flare timing
Enables rapid evolutionary turnover within single spin periods.

facts.claim: Persistent X/gamma flux and supercritical B impose strict selection pressures; life requires radiation-hard, magnet-aligned defect strategies with no Earth-analog multicell at mm scale.
facts.justification: Selection filters out macroscopic or weakly shielded architectures; only lattice-embedded defect ensembles survive.

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Drives convergent evolution toward degenerate-matter compatibility.
